message.content:
This editorial illustration shows the front cover of a magazine. A red vertical bar runs down the left edge, with a narrower red horizontal bar along the bottom. The background is white. At the top left, a "45" logo composed of colorful shapes sits above a small, unclear line of text. Centered at the top, black capital letters read "DAMAYANTI SERET ANGGOTA DEWAN". Below this, the word "TEMPO" appears in a large, black serif font. Underneath "TEMPO" is the date "25-31 JANUARI 2016".

The central image is a large, blue-inked fingerprint pattern. Contained within the ridges and whorls of the fingerprint is the subtle, halftone-style depiction of a human face, appearing as if the face is formed by the fingerprint lines. The fingerprint is slightly smudged and fades into white on its right side.

On the lower left, large red capital letters read "BAGAIMANA BOM THAMRIN DIRENCANAKAN", with the smaller name "Bahrun Naim" in black below. At the bottom right, the price "RP 39.500", a website, "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", an "ISSN" number, and a barcode are visible.
